shap_note: SHAP computed on a tree-based surrogate model over engineered features. Top features are ranked by mean absolute SHAP value.

feature_queries.name: user_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, (DATE_DIFF('day', u.CreationDate, e.timestamp)) AS account_age_days FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = e.OwnerUserId

feature_queries.name: post_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(p.Id) AS post_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS question_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.PostTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last_3m, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last_6m, SUM(CASE WHEN p.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS posts_last_12m, MAX(p.CreationDate) AS last_post_date FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: comment_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(c.Id) AS comment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_last_3m, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_last_6m, SUM(CASE WHEN c.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 12 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comments_last_12m, MAX(c.CreationDate) AS last_comment_date FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: badge_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_gold, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_silver, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Class=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badge_bronze, SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS badges_last_6m, MAX(b.Date) AS last_badge_date FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND b.Date < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: posthistory_stats
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(ph.Id) AS ph_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (1,2,3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_initial, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4,5,6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_edit, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.PostHistoryTypeId=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_question, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.PostHistoryTypeId=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_answer, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_last_3m, SUM(CASE WHEN ph.CreationDate >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 6 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ph_last_6m, MAX(ph.CreationDate) AS last_ph_date FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN postHistory ph ON ph.UserId = e.OwnerUserId AND ph.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp

feature_queries.name: recency
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, DATE_DIFF('day', p.last_post_date, e.timestamp) AS days_since_post, DATE_DIFF('day', c.last_comment_date, e.timestamp) AS days_since_comment, DATE_DIFF('day', b.last_badge_date, e.timestamp) AS days_since_badge, DATE_DIFF('day', ph.last_ph_date, e.timestamp) AS days_since_ph, (CASE WHEN p.last_post_date >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_post_3m, (CASE WHEN c.last_comment_date >= (e.timestamp - INTERVAL 3 MONTH) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_comment_3m FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN (SELECT OwnerUserId, MAX(CreationDate) AS last_post_date FROM posts WHERE CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY OwnerUserId) p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId LEFT JOIN (SELECT UserId, MAX(CreationDate) AS last_comment_date FROM comments WHERE CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY UserId) c ON c.UserId = e.OwnerUserId LEFT JOIN (SELECT UserId, MAX(Date) AS last_badge_date FROM badges WHERE Date < e.timestamp GROUP BY UserId) b ON b.UserId = e.OwnerUserId LEFT JOIN (SELECT UserId, MAX(CreationDate) AS last_ph_date FROM postHistory WHERE CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY UserId) ph ON ph.UserId = e.OwnerUserId

feature_queries.name: post_popularity
feature_queries.sql: SELECT e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp, COUNT(DISTINCT a.Id) AS answers_received, COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) AS comments_on_posts, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes_received, SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT v.Id) AS votes_received, COUNT(DISTINCT p.Id) AS own_posts FROM eval_table e LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = e.OwnerUserId AND p.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN posts a ON a.ParentId = p.Id AND a.PostTypeId=2 AND a.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id AND c.CreationDate < e.timestamp LEFT JOIN votes v ON v.PostId = p.Id AND v.CreationDate < e.timestamp GROUP BY e.OwnerUserId, e.timestamp
